curated-gf-flow-block-fs-rowan: Flow Block has a compact middle band with tall ascenders, like a letter buttoned up at the collar, and every stroke looks rope-thick. Rowan, a classic serif with generous curve openings and a friendlier, literary hand, softens it, better for brief copy than for pages (say, a leatherwork stamp).
curated-gf-flow-block-gf-aoboshi-one: Aoboshi One is a text serif with classic, traditional manners and small lowercase beside its capitals, so it is not meant for long paragraphs. And Flow Block, with its rope-like strokes and tall ascenders, does the loud work, as on a soda shop ice cream sign.
curated-gf-flow-block-gf-biz-udmincho: Flow Block's rope-like strokes sit buttoned up tight under tall ascenders. BIZ UDMincho, a classic serif with shallow curls and wide gaps, opens everything back up, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-flow-circular-gf-sansation: Every stroke here looks like steel cable outline, with narrow-mouthed c shapes. Sansation, an approachable sans with open curves, gives the pair its strongest quality: made for short stretches of reading, it lets Flow Circular be loud.
curated-gf-flow-circular-gf-wellfleet: Flow Circular looks like steel cable bent into short, tall-stemmed letters. Wellfleet, a text serif with small lowercase and a marker-nib line, brings the refined, traditional touch, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-flow-rounded-gf-kay-pho-du: Flow Rounded keeps one constant stroke width and a pursed look, which would suit a coffee roaster for outdoorsy types. And Kay Pho Du, a text serif with breathing counters and a rolling-ball pen trail, is made for short stretches of reading.
curated-gf-fondamento-gf-cardo: Cardo reads literary and dignified, with softly varied strokes. Its strongest quality is a classic serif gravity that steadies Fondamento's relaxed pen lettering, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-fontdiner-swanky-gf-coustard: Fontdiner Swanky spaces its letters out with generous room and faint modulation. Coustard, a text serif with a plain, bookish build, quietly holds the lines beneath it, ready for a jam jar label.
curated-gf-fontdiner-swanky-gf-line-seed: LINE Seed JP is approachable, with horizontals as heavy as its verticals (handy on a craft brewery label). And Fontdiner Swanky, spaced wide with subdued contrast, adds the swagger above it, better for brief copy.
curated-gf-fredericka-the-great-gf-ibm-p: Commanding heavy curves pinch into hairline ends in Fredericka the Great, a heading with real presence. And IBM Plex Mono, structured and typewriter-like, sets out widely spaced letters that feel comfortable in small doses.
